# snipeit_department (Data Source)

Looks up a single department by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_department" "it" {
  name = "IT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the department. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the department. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (Number) Id of the company this department belongs to.
- `location_id` (Number) Id of the location of this department.
- `manager_id` (Number) Id of the user managing this department.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
